newsitem.title: USA: AT&T Worldnet users hit by E-mail glitch.
newsitem.headline: AT&T Worldnet users hit by E-mail glitch.

text.p: AT&T Corp said on Friday that half of its 425,000 Worldnet Internet users have been hit by a an electronic mail problem that halts message delivery.

"E-Mail is being sent, it is just not being received. It will be stored in the datatbase, we just can't deliver it yet," said spokeswoman Patty Allen. AT&T hopes to resolve the problem by this evening, she said.
The snags were first reported by web-based news service CNet, which said Worldnet users first reported experiencing problems on Thursday afternoon.
Allen said that the problems were caused by hardware failures in the database servers. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1610
